units.source_text: 这是阿雪在艺伎馆里牢牢建立起来的自信。

en.t: This was the confidence that Axue had firmly built up in the geisha house.

units.source_text: 她自己并没有意识到，然而事实上她是认真地给了继母一点颜色看。

en.t: She herself was not aware of it, but in fact she had quite seriously shown her stepmother what she was capable of.

units.source_text: 继母碰上这种颜色，不由得后退一步。

en.t: Faced with that display, her stepmother could not help taking a step back.

units.source_text: 阿雪以一个掌握了新武器的人的胆量，开始蔑视人生。

en.t: With the courage of someone who had gained a new weapon, Axue began to look down on life.

units.source_text: 她的命运，是向娼妓的道路迈进了一步。

en.t: Her fate had taken one step forward along the road toward becoming a prostitute.
